annualization: monthly alpha times 12; volatility times square root of 12
inference: OLS with HAC covariance, maximum lag 2
long_only_dependent_return: portfolio return minus one-month risk-free rate
monthly_portfolio_return: sum of frozen beginning-of-test weights times CRSP firm monthly returns; no outcome-driven reweighting
primary_panel: calendar-time equal average of all live vintages within method
secondary_panel: each vintage separately; never pooled as independent observations
standard_factors: current monthly US Fama-French 5 factors and momentum from Kenneth French Data Library
